{"lean_source": "import Std

namespace JoinContract

inductive Mode where
  | inner
  | left
  | full

inductive Json where
  | null
  | bool (b : Bool)
  | num (n : Nat)
  | str (s : String)
  | arr (xs : List Json)
  | obj (xs : List (String × Json))

structure Row where
  key : Option Json

structure Pair where
  left : Option Row
  right : Option Row

def keyEq (a b : Option Json) : Bool :=
  match a, b with
  | .none, _ => false
  | _, .none => false
  | .some .null, _ => false
  | _, .some .null => false
  | .some (Json.bool x), .some (Json.bool y) => x = y
  | .some (Json.num x), .some (Json.num y) => x = y
  | .some (Json.str x), .some (Json.str y) => x = y
  | .some (Json.arr x), .some (Json.arr y) => List.map Json.hash x = List.map Json.hash y
  | .some (Json.obj x), .some (Json.obj y) => List.map Json.hash x = List.map Json.hash y
  | _, _ => false
end

def solve (left : List Row) (right : List Row) (mode : Mode) : List Pair :=
  let matchedRight : List Nat :=
    List.filter (fun j => left.any (fun l => keyEq l.key (right[j]!.key))) (List.range right.length)
  let matchedLeft : List Nat :=
    List.filter (fun i => right.any (fun r => keyEq (left[i]!.key) r.key)) (List.range left.length)
  let core : List Pair :=
    List.flatten (List.map (fun i =>
      let l := left[i]!
      let rs := List.filter (fun j => keyEq l.key (right[j]!.key)) (List.range right.length)
      List.map (fun j => { left := .some l, right := .some (right[j]!) }) rs
    ) (List.range left.length))
  let leftExtra : List Pair :=
    List.filterMap (fun i =>
      let l := left[i]!
      if left.any (fun l => keyEq l.key (right.any (fun r => r.key) (List.range right.length))) then
        none
      else
        some { left := .some l, right := .none }
    ) (List.range left.length)
  let rightExtra : List Pair :=
    List.filterMap (fun j =>
      let r := right[j]!
      if right.any (fun r => keyEq (left.any (fun l => l.key) (List.range left.length)) r.key) then
        none
      else
        some { left := .none, right := .some r }
    ) (List.range right.length)
  match mode with
  | .inner => core
  | .left => core ++ leftExtra
  | .full => core ++ leftExtra ++ rightExtra
end

def valid (left : List Row) (right : List Row) (mode : Mode) : Prop :=
  True

theorem thm_join (left : List Row) (right : List Row) (mode : Mode) (h : valid left right mode) :
  ∀ (l : Row) (r : Row), keyEq l.key r.key ↔ keyEq r.key l.key := by sorry

theorem non_vacuity :
  ∃ (left : List Row) (right : List Row) (mode : Mode), valid left right mode ∧
  ∃ (left2 : List Row) (right2 : List Row) (mode2 : Mode), valid left2 right2 mode2 := by sorry

end JoinContract",
